show.description: When power crushes the weak, will one man’s courage be enough to stand tall? Wang Xiaoer, a humble farmer, defies corruption and fights for justice in a world built to silence him. Listen to an inspiring tale of grit, rebellion, and unbreakable spirit. Watch Now!
